note: From the Description of Microtermes insperatus in Thakur et al. 1992 (Treubia 30(3)); the material comprises 3 soldiers and 4 workers from Carita, and only the soldier is described and measured (Table 22); the worker is not described. Distribution: Java, Indonesia (Bogor, Depok, Palimanan, Cimango, Jember and others) and Carita in the Krakatau Islands; also recorded from the Malay Peninsula.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, the frontal-gland area white, paler than the head capsule; frons, postclypeus, mandible bases and labrum yellow, darker than the head capsule; remaining parts paler than the head capsule. Hairs on the head capsule and thorax sparse; abdomen moderately hairy, each tergite with a row of hairs along the posterior margin. Body length about 3.80—4.25 mm. Head capsule broadly rounded, almost as long as wide; widest near the middle, the sides converging forwards and backwards; posterior margin rounded. Fontanelle indistinct. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 cylindrical, nearly as long as segments 3 and 4 together; segment 4 shortest; from segment 5 onwards clavate, gradually increasing; apical segment oval. Labrum nearly triangular, the sides at the base nearly parallel, tapering forwards to a point; with several long hairs. Mandibles thin, the apices strongly hooked; about 3/4 the length of the head capsule; outer margin deeply concave; inner margin with degenerate teeth near the apical end of the middle 2/3. Postmentum strongly arched; widest near the middle; anterior margin nearly straight; posterior margin concave. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior lobe strongly raised, nearly circular, broadly concave in the middle, the sides converging backwards and inwards; posterior margin nearly straight, with a very weak median concavity. Mesonotum slightly narrower than the pronotum, posterior margin nearly straight, weakly concave in the middle. Metanotum wider than the pronotum, posterior margin weakly convex. Legs short, femora slender, fore tibia short and fossorial; tibial spur formula 3:2:2. Tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen nearly cylindrical, hairy. Cerci 2-segmented, about 0.13 mm long. Measurements (3 soldiers, range/mean, mm): body length about 3.80—4.25/4.00; head with mandibles 1.38—1.55/1.43; head length (to lateral mandible base) 0.75—0.90/0.85; maximum head width 0.75—0.90/0.83; maximum head height 0.55—0.63/0.58; head index I (width/length) 0.98—1.00/0.99; mandible length left 0.58—0.63/0.60, right 0.58—0.63/0.60; head-mandible index 0.70—0.77/0.74; minimum median postmentum length 0.48—0.55/0.51; maximum postmentum width 0.35—0.45/0.41; pronotal length 0.35—0.43/0.38; maximum pronotal width 0.58—0.63/0.60; pronotal index 0.67—0.74/0.70.
